kind.limit: Lowercase extension->registered type is accepted I2, not retained lookup proof. Registry/kind table does not identify the browser view/filter or decode media.

locations.limit: Config/SQL names support conditional location bookkeeping; no live sidebar or active service instance.

gate.limit: Reader/queue pop retained; enumeration/enqueue of each actual sidecar remains I1.

format.limit: Header/table association conditional; unknown platforms/packet/error presentation not supplied by shipped conformity.

binding.limit: Query slots/apply body are historical independently reviewed evidence; six query/apply entries were not retained as full C records. Direct-child folder branch differs from pack ancestor query. In-memory prune != disk rewrite.

values.limit: stoul low32 rule has retained historical instruction/PC proof in review section2; no new decoder. Library error/public catch and hide flag behavior unknown. Own colour model is not X.

writer.limit: I5 base User Library/I6 pack identity/I7 UUID text remain accepted assumptions. No scheduler/flush/whole edit lifecycle; emptiness test and asset/hash condition not settled.

reimport.limit: Task push/pop and sidecar reader do not prove task ordering, SQLite commit, flush, complete rebuild or browser refresh.

preview.limit: Index lookup orders candidate paths only; caller root/actual player/audio/ASD lifecycle unknown.

watch.limit: String/task/SQL associations are source-only, not actual OS notification, deletion transaction ordering or UI update.

cache.limit: Conditional version/corrupt-marker mechanism; actual DB file, permissions, selection/upgrade/repair success and browser refresh remain unobserved. SQLite storage layout is excluded architecture.

launch.limit: Main Live source domain, distinct from helper addresses. Options and bounded restart controller do not prove scanner service, browser consumption or end-to-end UI lifecycle.

source_limit: No new source export, binary read, decoder, class resolution or provider traversal. Helper and main Live address domains never coalesced.
